rationale: Based on the historical job runtimes (approx. 235s to 245s), a timeout-minutes value can be derived. Using the paper's suggested buffer multiplier of 1.1, the calculated timeout is 245 * 1.1 = 269.5 seconds, which is approximately 4.5 minutes. I will set the job timeout to 5 minutes to provide a safe but significantly reduced limit compared to the default 360 minutes, while ensuring the existing workload can complete.
